material_proof: Exact task012 profile/save and source/executable binding; same-run native World and starting turn; native proof of camp footprint, unlit braziers/no fire or smoke, no prior cannibal site knowledge and no active outing/raid; then actual 24-hour time advancement with native metadata and a fresh saved turn at meaningful intervals covering camp memory, scouts, reports, dispatch, outings and relevant NPC IDs/actions; exact source attribution for any discovery, raid or unrelated natural contact; graceful process cleanup by PID/birth.
current_uncertainty: Whether the prepared clean no-fire state remains undiscovered and raid-free across one full native day, and whether all required native metadata and fresh saves are available at intervals.
